name: Print-on-Demand (Merch, Apparel, Gifts)

yield.notes: Per-design earnings are low ($2–$5 profit margin per sale). Scale requires large design catalog.

flags: Merch by Amazon is invite-only (start with Redbubble/Printify instead)
Thin margins: $2-5 per item after platform cuts
AI-generated art policy varies by platform

prerequisites: Design tool (Canva free, Adobe Express, or Midjourney for AI art)
startup_checklist: Create accounts on Redbubble and Printify (free, no invite needed)
Research trending niches using Everbee or manual search on Etsy/Redbubble
Use Canva or AI image generation to create first 20 designs in niche
Upload designs across multiple product types (t-shirt, mug, phone case, tote)
Tag designs with SEO-optimized titles and descriptions
failure_modes: Designs don't find niche audience — no organic sales
Platform changes algorithm or removes products
AI art flagged for copyright issues
kill_criteria: Less than 5 sales after 90 days with 50+ designs published
Platform bans account for policy violation
sources_note: Margin estimates from Printify and Redbubble published payout calculators.
